description: Four units whose second extension substream header states other static fields (no embedded stereo downmix) and has a CRC-16 that fails: the third and fourth units follow the first unit's fields.

crosscheck.whole_not: Read past end of EXSS asset descriptor

skip.ffprobe_bitrate: ffmpeg's lossless decoder sets the bit rate to 0 (dca_xll.c: avctx->bit_rate = 0), so ffprobe lists none
skip.decode_alone: a unit whose header omits the static fields is rejected by ffmpeg when decoded alone; the whole file is decoded with its checksum error named
